input: Find sports (team sports, gymnastics, martial arts, swimming, tennis, golf and others) summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Black Mountain, Swannanoa, Montreat and Old Fort, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Black Mountain summer sports camps 2026 2025 kids
Camp Grier summer camp 2026 mountain biking swimming
Camp Merri Mac 2027 sports tennis gymnastics

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: Cavalier and Nike sports camps include baseball, soccer, tennis and lacrosse; some activities take place in Black Mountain.

candidates.name: Warren Wilson College
candidates.note: College coaches offered full-day and half-day youth basketball camps in June, July and August 2026.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: Nike basketball at Warren Wilson College and baseball, tennis and lacrosse camps at Montreat College.

candidates.name: Girls on the Run of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Camp GOTR for rising grades 3–5 combined movement games and friendship activities at Christmount in July 2026.

candidates.name: Carolinas Fellowship of Christian Athletes
candidates.note: July 2026 residential leadership camp for middle- and high-school student-athletes at YMCA Blue Ridge Assembly.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Day and overnight camps include mountain-bike specialty programs, canoeing, swimming and outdoor adventure.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camps announced for 2027 include swimming, water sports, paddling, climbing and mountain biking.

candidates.name: Ridgecrest Summer Camps
candidates.note: Runs Camp Ridgecrest for Boys and Camp Crestridge for Girls, with sports and outdoor activities near Black Mountain.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight sessions announced for 2027; activities include gymnastics, tennis, swimming, riding and team sports.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight adventure and sports camp with 2027 sessions; campers attend in Marion, not its Black Mountain winter office.

candidates.name: Higher Ground Adventures
candidates.note: Weeklong Christian overnight camp for teens, with team sports, swimming and outdoor adventure; 2025 program documented.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Summer Clubs day camp serves children through recent high-school graduates, with supervised games and outdoor recreation.

candidates.name: Ninjaville
candidates.note: East Asheville summer camps feature ninja obstacles, agility, gymnastics and active games; 2026 sessions documented.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: East Asheville Christian day and overnight camps include swimming, archery and outdoor adventure; operated in 2026.
